text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — final launch orchestration for Emberwave is tomorrow. Embargo 10:00 PT. Topline checklist we need to lock: blog post + 2-3 bullets, full changelog, docs links live, webinar setup, canary demo, and SDR inbound routing. Can eng confirm changelog publish time and docs URL?

Liam: Ash will handle the changelog/docs publishing. Plan is merge by 09:40 PT and publish by 09:45 PT.

Ash: Confirmed. I’ll open the changelog PR at 09:30 PT, merge at ~09:40, and trigger docs deploy immediately after. Docs URL will be https://docs.redwood.com/emberwave/v1 (will post the exact permalink after deploy).

Zoe: Webinar is at 11:00 PT. We need a stable canary build for the live demo by 10:15 PT so ops can rehearse. Also need the benchmark narrative + 3 short prompt examples for the webinar slide deck.

Ash: Canary window booked 10:05–10:25 PT on the dedicated canary pool. Tag for the deploy: canary/emberwave-2026-03-23.

Jamal: I’ll provision the demo tenant at 09:55 PT and drop creds in LastPass. Liam — can you add a tiny seed script so the demo has real-looking data?

Liam: Yep — putting seed script in tools/demo. Usage: ```sh ./seed_demo.sh --count 20 --env=canary```. Also set the recommended UTMs: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=emberwave_launch.

Maya: Marketing needs a short changelog blurb by 09:00 PT (2–3 bullets + one customer quote). Social cadence: schedule first wave at 10:05 PT (immediately after docs are live). Legal/security signoff needed by 08:30 PT — @Olivia can you confirm?

Olivia: We reviewed the release draft and requested one tiny wording tweak in the billing section. Will sign off by 08:25 PT after that fix.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: emberwave canary at 10:05 PT. Estimated window: 10 minutes.

Zoe: Inbound leads — route webinar registrations and demo requests to SDR queue "EMB_LAUNCH". Liam, can you add the HubSpot webhook and ensure UTM tags are preserved? Also add referral tag "emberwave-launch" to the payload.

Liam: Webhook added under Prod -> Integrations -> HubSpot. Routing rules created and a test event was pushed just now.

Jamal: Test event received and parsed. Mapping includes: email, company, intent_score, utm_campaign. SDR playbook link: https://internal.redwood/sdr/emberwave_playbook (sharing with SDR ops).

Maya: OK final cadence for clarity: 08:25 legal signoff, 09:00 marketing copy final, 09:30 open PR, 09:40 merge, 09:45 changelog publish, 09:50 docs live, 10:05 social + canary, 11:00 webinar. Any blockers or objections?

Ash: No blockers from infra. Will be in #release-war-room from 08:45 for roll call.

Liam: :thumbsup:

Zoe: Thanks — I’ll post final copy at 08:20 and ping product for the customer quote.

Maya: Appreciate it. If anything slips, call a 30m delay and we’ll shift the webinar.

(End of thread)
